full: Qalam is a free learning app. It gives lessons, worksheets to print and answers to questions about school lessons. It shows no advertising.

Qalam never asks for a name, a photo, a phone number or where you live. A learner is a picture and a number, like "Book 27". Questions are kept for 60 days so the teacher can answer them; which lessons were done is kept for 12 months as counts, without a name.
The teacher at this centre reads questions and checks answers. Everything stays on this centre's computer: nothing is sent over the internet.
You can stop at any time: Settings, then "Stop sharing". What the centre's computer keeps about this learner is then deleted. Lessons on the phone still work.
